sources.note: Marketing education rules are editorial templates, NOT a verified product or ranking score source.

policies.authority: Never change TrustFolio API product identity, order or price.
policies.price: Require per-product freshness and permitted rights for publication; historical demo watermark always on.
policies.specification: Speak only a source-matched product feature; never infer watts, star rating, family size, performance, warranty or battery life.
policies.ranking: Rank position is an API fact, but underlying reason is unknown without trustworthy factor data.
policies.language: Hinglish drafted; Hindi/English translations require voice QA before production.
